review:
A hand-drawn Arthurian Trueways game where King Arthur, Merlin, the Dragon and the Lady of the Lake land as towering, whole-reel symbols.

There are four different Hold and Win bonuses, one for each character, which stops the feature from feeling repetitive. Medium-high volatility, a 3,000x max and a 97.1% RTP. Bonuses about once every 223 spins. Lovely art, too.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
